source_precision.issue: The description 'only non-singleton class is X' does not literally describe the singleton-X case.
source_precision.treatment: Define the class X and all outside singleton classes, covering |X|=1 uniformly.
source_precision.classification: compilation endpoint clarification, no author-issued erratum

source_precision.issue: Zero variance may let the unlifted point w coincide with a diagonal base point.
source_precision.treatment: Note that the equality branch lambda = sigma forces sigma > 0, so the added point is distinct from the base.
source_precision.classification: explicit omitted endpoint explanation; source result unchanged

source_precision.issue: The coordinate theorem does not require X to span its stated ambient R^d.
source_precision.treatment: State that lambda is the last-coordinate height, equal to the distance from the affine hull when X spans R^d.
